_comment: SGODOT-226 anchors on the Basic Room (layout metres, Y up), now with SGODOT-213's kitchen (#435): kitchen_range_3 replaces the hearth and the kettle, and the Spice Rack and the cookbook are layout pieces. Names follow WP7-B F-03 ③ and the Deluxe Room kitchen hooks (use_spice_rack / use_warming_cabinet). Stoves 1 / 2 / 3 are the range's three burners left to right, use_stove_N on its stove_N_top (the pot's floor, y 0.98); drop_pot_N on pot_normal's mouth 0.14 above it (the farmhouse moves it to the Big Pot's mouth, 0.18, while that stove has one: SGODOT-282 stove_pot.glb); badge_stove_N 0.43 above drop_pot and cam_stove(_N) 0.26 above the burner, 0.06 forward, as in the Standard Room. They show from Homestead Lv4 / Lv8 (the server's stove count), not by module. The Spice Rack (layout spice_rack.glb, shown from Lv2: module_levels) keeps use_spice_rack; the Warming Cabinet (Lv3) is the Warming Cabinet model (SGODOT-282, glass option B, assets/props/warming_cabinet/; 上官婉儿's integration): scale 1, its pivot on its back plane at x −2.850; its own materials with the room's specular 0.28 (no atlas: it would cover the dishes), use_warming_cabinet on its top_center. hearth_glow: the room's hearth lamp in front of burner 1 (fire_1's x, 0.23 m before the range's face, the old hearth lamp's height 0.53, its energy unchanged): inside the range (layout fire_position) it left the floor before the stove cooler than the old hearth did (不知火舞 on 213 9feeb7ed). spawn 1.8 m in from the door (亚瑟 11-09, 不知火舞 on 441, 197 00a0ca99): at 0.75 the door's Farm strip opened over the player's head.
